page.overview:
Who is Sidian?

Sidian is an admin of the Explorers and a major antagonist appearing in .

Sidian is mostly portrayed as a stoic and serious individual. He has a tendency to disobey orders, much like Coral, however, he is more subdued and finds Coral's actions to be more reckless than him. Often times, Sidian has to keep Coral's attitude in check and make sure that they do not stray from their objectives. He is also honorable as he prefers to fight fair without any dirty tactics as shown in his battle against Liko.
